title: Building and testing a level
description: In the level editor, the player names a level GO, places an entrance, an exit and a floor of bricks, then a snake, spikes and gold bars, erasing one. Edit Info sets the music, the starting hearts, the bombs and the next level; Test plays the level, where the player walks over the gold bar to the exit, and leaving it returns to the editor.
